paths.title: AI Research Academy
paths.tagline: From a single cited answer to a recurring, sourced research operation.
paths.description: A ladder of 8 hands-on lessons covering everything a working professional needs to research well with AI: asking ChatGPT web-search questions that return citation-backed answers, verifying sources like a professional, running focused market research with Gemini Deep Research, building a repeatable competitor analysis workflow in a ChatGPT Project, generating long-form reports with Gemini Deep Research, organizing an ongoing research project in ChatGPT Projects, turning verified research into client-ready decks and spreadsheets, and building a recurring research routine with Gemini's Scheduled Actions.
